original.description: A crowd pressed against a wall in Paris reading the mobilization posters, 2 August 1914. Catalogued by the Bibliothèque nationale de France as "2-8-14, mobilisation, la foule lisant les affiches : [photographie de presse]", with the subject headings "Guerre mondiale (1914-1918); France. Armée -- Mobilisation; Affiches" and the coverage date 2 August 1914.
original.photographer: Agence Rol (press agency; the operator is not named)
original.archive: Bibliothèque nationale de France, Agence Rol collection, reference Rol 41638; digitised on Gallica (btv1b69310853), via Wikimedia Commons
original.licence: public domain (Commons record: LicenseShortName "Public domain"; UsageTerms "Public domain"; the record’s permission note is publication before 1 January 1931). Credit line on the record: Bibliothèque nationale de France.

colorization.status: not colorized. Recommendation: colorize — a strong candidate for the mobilization beat, and the only documented colours needed are the summer street and the white of the posters.

content_policy: ok — a crowd in a street, no gore
caption: Paris, 2 August 1914: the crowd reading the mobilization posters. The order went up at four in the afternoon; the first day of mobilization was the 2nd, and the timetable took over from there.
credit: Original photograph: Agence Rol, Paris, 2 August 1914; Bibliothèque nationale de France, Rol 41638, via Gallica and Wikimedia Commons; public domain.
notes: Verified 2026-08-24 against the Commons file record via the MediaWiki API: title, Rol reference number, date and licence all read off the record. Hero candidate for the mobilization beat.
